from pathlib import Path
import json,copy,hashlib
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path('/Users/shopme/Documents/workspace/opendesk-browser')
E=ROOT/'docs/framework/evidence/f2-controller-product-native/native-2026-10-03T09-28-25.557Z-b00dcdb8'
CHECKER=ROOT/'tests/framework/check-basic-save-evidence-20261003.py'
code=CHECKER.read_bytes()
expected='922eeeb216d965040523a76499735866ba4b37afdefdf28b4a602de2a1529a2e'
assert hashlib.sha256(code).hexdigest()==expected,'Checker drift after freeze'
ns={'__name__':'bounded_basic_save_review','__file__':str(CHECKER)}
exec(compile(code,str(CHECKER),'exec'),ns)
raw=[json.loads(line) for line in (E/'raw-cdp.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines()]
def load(label):
    d=E/f'production-{label}'
    return [json.loads((d/'report.json').read_bytes()),
            [json.loads(line) for line in (d/'ui-input.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines()],
            json.loads(next(d.glob('revision-*-r1.json')).read_bytes()),
            copy.deepcopy(raw),
            json.loads((d/'native-permission-state.json').read_bytes())]
out=[]
def inspect(name,finding,label,change=None):
    data=load(label)
    if change:change(data)
    try:
        r=ns['inspect_transcript'](*data)
        out.append({'name':name,'finding':finding,'accepted':r['savePrefixVerified'],
                    'originalCaseStatus':r['originalCaseStatus'],'f3Accepted':r['f3Accepted'],
                    'nativeSaveProof':r['nativeSaveProof']})
    except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError) as e:
        out.append({'name':name,'finding':finding,'accepted':False,'error':str(e)})
inspect('unchanged actual138 prefix','CONTROL','138')
inspect('unchanged actual154 drift rejection','CONTROL','154')
def hide_drift(data):
    report=data[0]
    assert report['launcherSha256']!=report['launcherAfterSha256']
    report['launcherDrift']=False
inspect('154 unequal launcher hashes with boolean relabelled false','BSR-01','154',hide_drift)
def constant_idb(data):
    msgs=data[3]
    row=msgs[128]
    assert row['message']['method']=='Runtime.evaluate'
    value=msgs[129]['message']['result']['result']['value']
    expression='(()=>{const markers="indexedDB.open(\'opendesk-browser\') \'readonly\'";return '+json.dumps(value,separators=(',',':'))+';})()'
    row['message']['params']['expression']=expression
inspect('IDB response supplied by literal return with marker string, no IDB access','BSR-02','138',constant_idb)
def wrong_head_key(data):
    data[3][129]['message']['result']['result']['value']['rows']['scriptHeads'][0]['key']='script:["wrong-namespace","wrong-id"]'
inspect('committed head exists only under wrong primary key','BSR-04','138',wrong_head_key)

# Virtual reads keep every existing file untouched. Both labels refer to the
# same actual138 browser trace; Browser.getVersion still says Chrome/138.
data138=load('138')
r138,ui138,rev138,_,perm138=data138
r154=copy.deepcopy(r138);r154['label']='154'
virtual_raw=[copy.deepcopy(r) for r in raw if r['endpoint'].startswith('production-138-')]
for r in copy.deepcopy(virtual_raw):
    r['endpoint']=r['endpoint'].replace('production-138-','production-154-',1)
    virtual_raw.append(r)
actual_read=Path.read_bytes
mapping={
    (E/'raw-cdp.jsonl').resolve():b'\n'.join(json.dumps(r,separators=(',',':')).encode() for r in virtual_raw)+b'\n',
    (E/'production-154/report.json').resolve():json.dumps(r154).encode(),
    (E/'production-154/ui-input.jsonl').resolve():b'\n'.join(json.dumps(r).encode() for r in ui138)+b'\n',
    (E/'production-154/native-permission-state.json').resolve():json.dumps(perm138).encode(),
    next((E/'production-154').glob('revision-*-r1.json')).resolve():json.dumps(rev138).encode(),
}
def virtual_read(path):
    resolved=path.resolve()
    return mapping[resolved] if resolved in mapping else actual_read(path)
with patch.object(Path,'read_bytes',virtual_read):
    result=ns['verify'](E,r138['packageHash'],['138','154'])
out.append({'name':'actual138 trace duplicated as label154; real versions and browser identity equal',
            'finding':'BSR-03','accepted':result['allSavePrefixesVerified'],
            'browsers':[r['environment']['browser'] for r in result['observations']],
            'originalCaseStatuses':[r['originalCaseStatus'] for r in result['observations']],
            'f3Accepted':result['f3Accepted'],'original603Closed':result['original603Closed'],
            'method':'verify() exact code, Path.read_bytes virtual mapping; package read actually from disk',
            'sameBrowserPid':r138['pid'],'sameBrowserEndpoint':r138['endpoint']})
assert hashlib.sha256(CHECKER.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,'Checker changed during review'
print(json.dumps({'checkerSha256':expected,'checks':out,'existingFilesModified':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
